# Apps excluded from the generic compose-boot-test healthcheck-poll job.
#
# Single source of truth — read by:
#   - pr-checks.yml: detect-changes' "Determine which compose stacks to
#     boot-test" step (feeds compose-boot-test's matrix)
#   - pr-checks.yml: compose-syntax-check (the fallback check for exactly
#     the apps compose-boot-test skips)
#   - boot-test-all.yml: list-apps (feeds compose-boot-test-all's matrix)
#
# One app name per line. Blank lines and full-line '#' comments are
# ignored when this file is parsed; per-app reasoning below stays
# attached to the app it explains.

# bind9, seaweedfs, caddy: already covered by their own molecule
# scenarios with stronger, real-protocol assertions (DNS resolution, S3
# error semantics) than a generic healthcheck poll would add.
bind9
seaweedfs
caddy

# tinyauth: appUrl resolves fine in CI (see main.yaml's tinyauth_host and
# lab_domain). The actual blocker is AuthService's LdapService bootstrap,
# a hard startup dependency — compose-boot-test brings up each app's
# compose stack in isolation on its own runner (see
# _compose-boot-test.yml), so there's no lldap host for tinyauth to
# resolve, in this job or any other, regardless of config correctness.
tinyauth
